profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer at Telestream

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed 3D printer software running on Debian Linux.   Helped bring the NextDent 300 dental printer from prototype to a finished product.  Worked closely with EE and mechanical teams to develop power on self tests of various hardware systems including fans, motors, pumps, heaters, thermistors.  Found and resolved a deep bug in the Linux kernel driver code that was causing random FPGA register writes to be clobbered. Tools Used:  GCC, Docker, Jira, Git, Bash, VMware, Ansible, Oscilloscope

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Created embedded software in both C and C++ for Ethernet packet broker switches.  Was the person primarily responsible for the bootcode (u-boot), and Linux kernel customization for all boards in the system.  Implemented recipe based build system for the root filesystem and all our custom software with yocto.  Worked closely with the hardware team to improve designs and make them more easily managed with the software.  Brought up the initial software on almost all new hardware designs.  Developed device drivers for I2C sensors, touch-screen displays, and fan controllers. Managed the Jenkins automated build system and the subversion source control servers.  Created yocto and docker toolchains for both the Jenkins builds and the manual developer builds.  These were both cross-compiler based tools for ARM, MIPS, and POWER-PC as well as x86 native.  Integrated bluetooth low energy stack into Linux and created a mobile application used to access the device.  Tools Used:  GCC, Perl, Python, Bash, Yocto, Buildroot, Subversion, Jenkins, Eclipse, Code Collaborator, Mantis, Confluence

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed embedded software for broadcast displays.  Created solutions using Pixelworks, VXP, and Altera FPGA image processors.  Wrote device drivers for SDI, HDMI, and DVI inputs.  Developed Quad Viewer and 4K monitor systems using Altera VIP and NIOS II.  Designed and implemented serial protocol interfaces for monitor control, tally, and debug.  Used Visual C++ to write test tools and development tools.  Designed and implemented OSD engine used in Altera FPGA based systems.  Worked in all areas of embedded software on x86, ARM, and NIOS II processors from the boot code all the way up to the RTOS and application code. Learned Verilog and wrote FPGA code for HDMI input module.

positions.title: Senior System Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented advanced television software for tier 1 customers. Developed USB device driver for the integrated USB core in Pixelworks’ image processors. Partnered with ASIC team find and solve problems with the USB core integration. Modified windows debugging tools to connect to target platforms using USB. Developed embedded device driver code for external keystone scaler solution for projector platforms. Worked on the initial design and specification of a Windows Network Projector solution using Windows CE.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed firmware for embedded systems built around Hitachi H8 microcontrollers. Responsible for maintaining and extending serial protocols used to interface to slot machines, VFD displays, and the back of house database system. Maintained and developed software for the Bank Controller (A NX486 board running the PSOS Real Time OS). Designed and implemented a programming language for developing slot machine player interfaces. Wrote a simulator in MFC to simulate the Acres Bonusing System for firmware development and testing.
